raw.buffDescription: When the Defender Blocks an attack, they gain an Indefinite 25% [k=glossary/armor_up]Armor Up[/k] Buff. Upon reaching 5 stacks of these Armor Ups, they are removed and the Attacker takes a burst of Direct Damage equal to 25% of their Max Health.
